items.title: Reuters: 'The show must go on' -- struggling luxury brands seek catwalk boost in Milan and Paris as slowdown deepens
items.summary: Reuters wire story reports Kering shares have erased all gains made since CEO Luca de Meo took over a year ago, framing this week's Milan and Paris shows (LVMH down 37% YTD) against a worsening sector slowdown -- Middle East conflict squeezing consumer budgets just as appetite for high-end handbags fades. Cites Deloitte Advisory that fewer than half of luxury brands are currently growing, and Tod's chairman Diego della Valle calling this a multi-year 'holding period.' Genuine independent critical/skeptical framing of the runway-show-as-turnaround-proof narrative, not brand-authored.

items.title: The Globe and Mail: Luxury fashion stocks seek boost from Milan, Paris bets as growth prospects worsen
items.summary: Companion Reuters-sourced piece adds that middle-class shoppers are pulling back, intensifying competition among brands for a shrinking pool of wealthy consumers, and that hefty past price hikes have made even top-tier clients more value-conscious. Notes consumer spending rotating toward wellness, health/longevity and hospitality instead of luxury fashion goods -- direct structural headwind context for Gucci's Sept 25 Milan show this week.

items.title: WWD: Milan Fashion Week September 2026 edition -- what to know, Gucci among most closely watched
items.summary: Trade-press preview confirms Gucci, Dolce & Gabbana and Giorgio Armani show in Milan this week while LVMH's Dior and Louis Vuitton wait for Paris (from Sept 28). Frames runway shows -- which can cost up to EUR10 million to stage -- as under heightened pressure to prove a real return on investment for anxious shareholders, not just deliver spectacle. Neutral trade framing that nonetheless surfaces the commercial-pressure angle.

items.title: lifestylemadeinitaly.it: Milan Fashion Week opens September 22 with Prada, Diesel farewell and Vogue World -- Gucci absent from day one
items.summary: Italian lifestyle-media day-one recap of MFW SS27 covers Prada's opening slot, Glenn Martens' farewell Diesel show and the evening's Vogue World Milano gala at Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II. Notably contains zero mention of Gucci, consistent with Gucci's own slot landing later Friday Sept 25 -- included to document that as of Sept 22-23 local Italian coverage cycle has not yet turned to Gucci, useful negative-space signal on pre-show buzz timing.

items.title: FashionUnited: Sabina Belli takes helm of Kering Italy, overseeing Gucci's home manufacturing base
items.summary: Former Pomellato CEO Sabina Belli becomes president of Kering Italia (effective Sept 15), reporting to Luca de Meo, with Italy described as home to the majority of Kering's industrial footprint including Gucci production. Straight leadership/governance reporting, neutral tone, relevant backdrop to this week's Milan show as new Italian leadership settles in during Gucci's highest-visibility week.

items.title: PurseForum thread: 'Is Gucci a safe brand to buy...?' -- prospective buyers weigh quality-control reputation before purchasing
items.summary: Active community thread where a prospective buyer asks longtime members whether Gucci is currently a safe/reliable purchase given the brand's mixed recent quality-control reputation; replies reference known complaint patterns (metallic leather-strap finish wearing off, uneven stitching) alongside members defending current construction quality as genuinely good. Organic unmoderated consumer risk-assessment chatter, distinct from the Sept 22 stitching-complaint thread already pooled; engagement counts (views/replies) not exposed in the fetched view, left null.

items.title: PurseForum thread archive resurfaces in active discussion: Gucci bag complaint over poor quality and customer service response
items.summary: Long-running community thread cataloguing recurring member complaints -- peeling leather, broken straps, fuzzy/uneven stitching -- and mixed customer-service outcomes (some resolved via repair credit, others charged for what buyers believe are factory defects). Genuine organic quality/CS sentiment; included for critical-angle balance since positive show-preview coverage currently dominates this week's pool. Engagement counts not exposed, left null.

items.title: CPP-Luxury: Gucci second-hand sales rise while new-product sales decline
items.summary: Trade outlet reports secondhand/resale-market Gucci sales increasing even as sales of new Gucci product decline -- a demand-shift signal read as double-edged: durable brand desirability in the resale market, but a warning sign that shoppers increasingly prefer buying Gucci used rather than new at current price points. Critical-angle business signal on value-for-money perception; kept despite being slightly outside the tightest freshness window because it directly informs this week's turnaround narrative and no fresher resale-specific EU item surfaced.

items.title: Instagram: street-style post capturing Gucci looks spotted at Milan Fashion Week SS27
items.summary: Public street-style account post documenting attendees wearing Gucci pieces around Milan Fashion Week venues during the Sept 22-28 show week. Organic fan/observer content rather than brand-owned marketing; included for SNS buzz-channel coverage ahead of Friday's runway show. Like/comment counts not retrievable via the fetched preview, left null.
